treatment: Hormone replacement therapy tailored to the specific endocrine gland affected (e.g., levothyroxine for hypothyroidism, cortisone acetate or prednisolone for hypoadrenocorticism, insulin for diabetes mellitus). Supportive care includes fluid therapy, electrolyte correction, and nutritional management. Regular monitoring of hormone levels and clinical signs is essential to adjust dosages appropriately.
treatment_ja: 障害を受けた内分泌腺に応じたホルモン補充療法を実施する（例：甲状腺機能低下症にはレボチロキシン、副腎皮質機能低下症には酢酸コルチゾンまたはプレドニゾロン、糖尿病にはインスリン）。補液療法、電解質補正、栄養管理などの支持療法を併用する。ホルモン値および臨床症状を定期的にモニタリングし、投与量を適切に調整することが不可欠である。

name: Endocrine Traumatic Injury (Others)
treatment: Stabilize the patient with IV fluid therapy and correct electrolyte imbalances. Initiate hormone replacement therapy based on the specific endocrine gland affected (e.g., dexamethasone for adrenal insufficiency, levothyroxine for thyroid damage, desmopressin for diabetes insipidus). Monitor hormone levels frequently and provide supportive care including pain management and wound care for traumatic injuries.
treatment_ja: 静脈内輸液療法で患者を安定させ、電解質異常を補正する。損傷を受けた内分泌腺に応じたホルモン補充療法を開始する（例：副腎不全にはデキサメタゾン、甲状腺損傷にはレボチロキシン、尿崩症にはデスモプレシン）。ホルモン値を頻繁にモニタリングし、疼痛管理および外傷部位の創傷ケアを含む支持療法を実施する。

name: Endocrine Behavioral Disorder (Others)
treatment: Identify and address the underlying endocrine disorder through hormone assays and diagnostics. Administer appropriate hormone replacement or suppression therapy (e.g., melatonin implants, deslorelin, trilostane, or levothyroxine depending on the specific endocrinopathy). Provide environmental enrichment and behavioral modification as adjunctive supportive care.
treatment_ja: ホルモン検査および各種診断により基礎となる内分泌疾患を特定し治療を行う。特定された内分泌疾患に応じて、適切なホルモン補充療法または抑制療法（メラトニンインプラント、デスロレリン、トリロスタン、レボチロキシンなど）を実施する。補助的支持療法として環境エンリッチメントおよび行動修正を併用する。

name: Endocrine Infectious Disease (Others)
treatment: Identify and treat the underlying infectious agent with appropriate antimicrobials (antibiotics, antifungals, or antivirals) based on culture and sensitivity. Provide hormone replacement therapy (e.g., levothyroxine, corticosteroids, desmopressin) as needed for endocrine deficiencies. Supportive care includes fluid therapy, electrolyte correction, and nutritional support.
treatment_ja: 培養・感受性試験に基づき、適切な抗菌薬（抗生物質、抗真菌薬、抗ウイルス薬）で原因感染症を治療する。内分泌機能不全に対しては、必要に応じてホルモン補充療法（レボチロキシン、コルチコステロイド、デスモプレシンなど）を実施する。補液療法、電解質補正、栄養管理などの支持療法も併せて行う。

name: Endocrine Parasitic Disease (Others)
treatment: Identify and treat the underlying parasitic infection with appropriate antiparasitic agents (e.g., ivermectin, fenbendazole, or praziquantel depending on species and parasite). Address endocrine dysfunction with hormone replacement or supportive therapy as needed. Provide fluid support, nutritional optimization, and monitor organ function during recovery.
treatment_ja: 原因となる寄生虫感染を特定し、種および寄生虫に応じた適切な駆虫薬（イベルメクチン、フェンベンダゾール、プラジカンテル等）で治療を行う。内分泌機能障害にはホルモン補充療法または対症療法を実施する。回復期には輸液療法、栄養管理、臓器機能のモニタリングを行い、全身状態の安定を図る。

name: Endocrine Viral Disease (Others)
treatment: No specific antiviral therapy exists for most endocrine-targeting viral diseases in exotic species. Supportive care includes fluid therapy, nutritional support, and hormone replacement (e.g., corticosteroids, thyroid supplementation) based on the affected endocrine gland. Anti-inflammatory agents (meloxicam 0.2-0.5 mg/kg) and broad-spectrum antibiotics for secondary infections may be indicated.
treatment_ja: エキゾチック動物における内分泌系を標的とするウイルス性疾患に対する特異的な抗ウイルス療法は存在しません。支持療法として輸液療法、栄養補助、障害された内分泌腺に応じたホルモン補充療法（コルチコステロイド、甲状腺ホルモン補充など）を実施します。抗炎症薬（メロキシカム0.2～0.5 mg/kg）および二次感染に対する広域スペクトル抗菌薬の投与が適応となる場合があります。

name: Endocrine Bacterial Disease (Others)
treatment: Initiate broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy (e.g., enrofloxacin, trimethoprim-sulfonamide, or amoxicillin-clavulanate) based on culture and sensitivity results. Address endocrine dysfunction with appropriate hormone replacement or suppression therapy. Provide supportive care including fluid therapy, nutritional support, and anti-inflammatory agents as needed.
treatment_ja: 培養感受性試験の結果に基づき、広域スペクトル抗生物質（エンロフロキサシン、トリメトプリム・スルホンアミド、アモキシシリン・クラブラン酸など）による治療を開始する。内分泌機能障害に対しては適切なホルモン補充療法または抑制療法を実施する。輸液療法、栄養補助、必要に応じた抗炎症薬投与などの支持療法を併用する。

name: Endocrine Fungal Disease (Others)
treatment: Systemic antifungal therapy with itraconazole (5-10 mg/kg PO daily) or fluconazole as first-line, combined with amphotericin B in severe cases. Address endocrine dysfunction with appropriate hormone replacement or supplementation. Provide supportive care including fluid therapy, nutritional support, and monitoring of adrenal/thyroid function throughout treatment.
treatment_ja: 全身性抗真菌療法としてイトラコナゾール（5-10 mg/kg 経口 1日1回）またはフルコナゾールを第一選択とし、重症例ではアムホテリシンBを併用する。内分泌機能障害に対しては適切なホルモン補充療法を実施する。輸液療法、栄養サポート、および治療期間中の副腎・甲状腺機能のモニタリングを含む支持療法を行う。

name: Endocrine Infection (Others)
treatment: Identify and treat the underlying infectious agent with appropriate antimicrobials (antibiotics, antifungals, or antiparasitics) based on culture and sensitivity testing. Provide hormone replacement therapy as needed for endocrine gland dysfunction (e.g., corticosteroids for adrenal insufficiency, thyroid supplementation). Supportive care includes fluid therapy, electrolyte correction, anti-inflammatory agents, and nutritional support.
treatment_ja: 培養・感受性試験に基づき、原因となる感染病原体に対して適切な抗菌薬（抗生物質、抗真菌薬、抗寄生虫薬）を投与します。内分泌腺機能障害に応じたホルモン補充療法（副腎不全に対する副腎皮質ステロイド、甲状腺ホルモン補充など）を実施します。輸液療法、電解質補正、抗炎症薬投与、栄養サポートなどの支持療法を併用します。

name: Endocrine Inflammation (Others)
treatment: Treat underlying cause of endocrine gland inflammation with appropriate anti-inflammatory therapy (e.g., prednisolone 0.5-1 mg/kg PO q12-24h, tapered gradually). Provide hormone replacement as needed based on gland affected (e.g., levothyroxine for thyroiditis, insulin for pancreatitis-related diabetes). Monitor electrolytes, glucose, and hormone levels regularly; supportive care includes fluid therapy and nutritional support.
treatment_ja: 内分泌腺の炎症の根本原因に対し、適切な抗炎症療法（例：プレドニゾロン0.5～1 mg/kg 経口 12～24時間毎、漸減投与）を実施する。障害された腺に応じてホルモン補充療法を行う（例：甲状腺炎にはレボチロキシン、膵炎関連糖尿病にはインスリン）。電解質、血糖値、ホルモン値を定期的にモニタリングし、輸液療法および栄養補助を含む支持療法を併用する。

name: Endocrine Neoplasia (Others)
treatment: Surgical excision of endocrine tumors is the primary treatment when feasible. For inoperable or metastatic cases, medical management includes mitotane, trilostane, or targeted chemotherapy depending on tumor origin. Supportive care with hormone replacement therapy and monitoring of electrolyte balance is essential post-operatively.
treatment_ja: 内分泌腫瘍の外科的切除が可能な場合は第一選択となる。手術不能または転移性の症例では、腫瘍の起源に応じてミトタン、トリロスタン、または標的化学療法による内科的管理を行う。術後はホルモン補充療法および電解質バランスのモニタリングを含む支持療法が不可欠である。

name: Endocrine Metabolic Disease (Others)
treatment: Identify and address the specific endocrine or metabolic disorder through appropriate hormone replacement or suppression therapy. Supportive care includes fluid therapy, electrolyte correction, and nutritional management. Monitor serum hormone levels and metabolic panels regularly to adjust treatment protocols accordingly.
treatment_ja: 特定の内分泌または代謝疾患を診断し、適切なホルモン補充療法または抑制療法を実施します。補液療法、電解質補正、栄養管理などの支持療法を行います。血清ホルモン値および代謝パネルを定期的にモニタリングし、治療プロトコルを適宜調整してください。

name: Endocrine Nutritional Deficiency (Others)
treatment: Identify and correct the specific nutritional deficiency through dietary supplementation (e.g., iodine, selenium, vitamin E, calcium, or vitamin D as indicated). Provide balanced species-appropriate diet reformulation. Administer supportive care including fluid therapy, electrolyte correction, and hormone replacement (e.g., levothyroxine for hypothyroidism) if endocrine dysfunction is confirmed.
treatment_ja: 特定の栄養欠乏症を同定し、適切な栄養補給（ヨウ素、セレン、ビタミンE、カルシウム、ビタミンDなど）を行います。種に適したバランスの取れた食事への再設計を実施します。輸液療法、電解質補正、および内分泌機能障害が確認された場合にはホルモン補充療法（例：甲状腺機能低下症に対するレボチロキシン投与）を含む支持療法を提供します。

name: Endocrine Genetic Disorder (Others)

Hormone replacement therapy (e.g., levothyroxine for hypothyroidism, cortisone acetate for adrenal insufficiency) is administered based on the specific endocrine deficiency identified. Genetic counseling for breeding management and lifelong monitoring of hormone levels are essential.

name: Endocrine Behavioral Disorder (Others)
treatment: Identify and address the underlying endocrine disorder through appropriate hormone replacement or suppression therapy (e.g., trilostane for hyperadrenocorticism, levothyroxine for hypothyroidism, or melatonin for adrenal-related behavioral changes). Concurrent behavioral modification and environmental enrichment should be implemented. Anxiolytic medications such as trazodone or fluoxetine may be considered as adjunctive therapy for persistent behavioral signs.

name: Endocrine Infectious Disease (Others)

name: Endocrine Parasitic Disease (Others)

Provide hormone replacement or suppression therapy as needed to correct endocrine imbalances caused by parasitic damage. Supportive care including fluid therapy, nutritional support, and anti-inflammatory agents (e.g., meloxicam) to manage secondary complications.

name: Endocrine Viral Disease (Others)

Supportive care includes fluid therapy, nutritional support, and hormone replacement as needed (e.g., levothyroxine or corticosteroids for glandular insufficiency). Monitor endocrine function via serial bloodwork and manage secondary infections with appropriate antimicrobials.

name: Endocrine Bacterial Disease (Others)

Address endocrine dysfunction with appropriate hormone replacement or supportive therapy. Provide fluid therapy, nutritional support, and anti-inflammatory agents as needed to stabilize the patient.
treatment_ja: 培養・感受性試験の結果に基づき、広域スペクトル抗菌薬（エンロフロキサシン、トリメトプリム・スルホンアミド、アモキシシリン・クラブラン酸など）による治療を開始する。内分泌機能障害に対しては適切なホルモン補充療法または支持療法を実施する。患者の安定化のため、輸液療法、栄養補助、および必要に応じて抗炎症薬を投与する。

name: Endocrine Fungal Disease (Others)
treatment: Systemic antifungal therapy with itraconazole (5-10 mg/kg PO daily) or fluconazole as first-line agents, combined with amphotericin B in severe cases. Address endocrine dysfunction with appropriate hormone replacement or suppression therapy. Provide supportive care including nutritional support and monitoring of adrenal and thyroid function throughout treatment.

Provide hormone replacement therapy as needed for affected endocrine glands. Supportive care includes fluid therapy, anti-inflammatories (e.g., meloxicam), nutritional support, and monitoring of endocrine function panels.

name: Endocrine Inflammation (Others)
treatment: Identify and address the underlying cause of endocrine gland inflammation. Administer anti-inflammatory therapy such as corticosteroids (prednisolone 0.5-1 mg/kg) or NSAIDs as appropriate for the species. Provide hormone replacement therapy if glandular function is compromised, along with supportive care including fluid therapy and nutritional support.

name: Endocrine Neoplasia (Others)
